annotations.title: Read a post, case study or page

description: The full text of a post, case study, page or project as Markdown, or one section of it. The id can be an id from search or list_content (such as "work/sleep-anchor"), a path ("/about"), a brentburgess.com URL, a brentburgess:// URI or a unique slug ("consulting"). Add #anchor for one section, as search results do.

id.description: What to read: an id, path, URL, URI or slug, with an optional #anchor

links.description: Where a case study’s running system can be seen

status_label.description: Its status as the site shows it

section.description: The section read, or null for the whole

truncated.description: Whether the text was cut at 60,000 characters

updated.description: When it was last updated, if it was
